label: mapped-host GPU gather for pipeline

expected_bottleneck: CPU gather and explicit H2D in prefill pipeline; b8 diagnostic75ms CPUgather and42ms transfer spans overlap compute but leave residualcriticalpath.
change: Replace pipeline backend with direct mapped-host gather on separate CUDAstream,64persistentCTAs, existinggroup/depth/capacity. Keep tinybulk algorithm and resident paths. Pin foldedCPUtable once; no GPUtablecache or approximate arithmetic.
tradeoffs: Entire3000MiB table page-locked, replacing smallstagingpinning; account totalpinnedtable andallCPUcopies.
Mapped kernels consumeSMresources and may contendwithmodelcompute; microbenchbenefit notsufficient.
Synchronize finaltable-read stream beforeforwardreturns to preserve subsequentCPUtablemutation/lifetime safety.
decision: 50 tests and standalone exactzero pass. Freeze12-job screen; alltiming usesfb17afb. Setup estimate30sec = prior measured~20sec plus10sec allowance for newJIT/pinning, not a measuredcandidatecost.
